title: Devil's Advocates
wikitext:
[[Image:961113-devilsadvocates2.jpg|frame|right|Devil's Advocates vs. [[The Vicious Vikings]], Nov '96]]
One if the first swedish clans. Clan member [[Hobbex]] was a central figure in the early Scandinavian Quake scene, running the first clan ranking site [[A Frag in the Darkness]] and playing a part in arranging both [[Fragfest '96]] and [[Quake SM '97]].
